entities.name: Robert Sabolič
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Sabolič is a Slovenian ice hockey player who plays for EC VSV in the ICE Hockey League (ICEHL). He participated at several IIHF World Championships as a member of the Slovenia men's national ice hockey team. He has previously played with Swedish ice hockey club Södertälje.
